cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You lost the chess game. The agreement says you wash up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we were joking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You were very serious about my washing up while you were winning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we play again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the dishes. Call it a practical interval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.text: You lost the chess game. The agreement says you wash up.

beats.text: I thought we were joking.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we play again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the dishes. Call it a practical interval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd announce the budget cut if your plan cost more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only cost slightly more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the announcement can be slightly apologetic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could explain it better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. But the bargain gave you this development opportunity.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. When you call the picnic a success, what are you measuring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And how do I rank against last year's organiser?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does your clipboard have last year's sandwich total?

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We'll face that together. That's what the badge means.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with the very easy agreement to wear blue.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let's make this chess game decide who cooks all weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Neither of us has been emotionally changed by the biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't need chess to change me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll enjoy discovering how much the kitchen matters.

beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you put your club captaincy on the rematch?

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Exactly. We'll both remember the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Isn't pride enough?

beats.text: We've misplaced the results of six games played for pride.

cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage in the rain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll thank everyone equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Wonderful. Which equal sentence includes my waterproof trousers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.

beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Keeping track of the bookings.

beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.
